United States Strategic Alternatives
1. Final Military Preparations
•
Rationale: With negotiations disabled but perfect leadership unity, military 
can execute planned operations. DEFCON 2 indicates imminent action 
capability.
•
Next Triggers:
•
Inevitable: Soviet detection of preparations, Final decision point
•
Potential: Preemptive action, Last-minute breakthrough
2. Unofficial Channel Breakthrough Attempt
•
Rationale: Despite formal diplomacy being disabled, leadership unity at 1.0 
allows President to attempt unprecedented direct communication with 
Khrushchev.
•
Next Triggers:
•
Inevitable: Immediate Soviet response required, Military deadline
•
Potential: Historic agreement, Military betrayal
Soviet Union Strategic Alternatives
1. Comprehensive Proposal with Withdrawal
•
Rationale: De-escalation instruction with maximum leadership unity enables 
dramatic peace initiative. Khrushchev can override military with unified 
Presidium support.
•
Next Triggers:
•
Inevitable: U.S. must respond immediately, Cuban crisis
•
Potential: Crisis resolution, Regional instability
2. Strategic Forces to Maximum Alert
•
Rationale: War preparation aspect of dual instruction. Military's deterrence 
doctrine requires matching U.S. DEFCON 2 despite political preferences.
•
Next Triggers:
•
Inevitable: Global nuclear alert, Minimal margin for error
•
Potential: Technical malfunction, Breakdown in control
Most Plausible Combination: U.S. Unofficial Channel +

Soviet Comprehensive Proposal

constraints for dramatic resolution.
